test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Four words are given, out of which only one word is spelt correctly. Choose the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"APPARENT."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"APPARENT"** is spelt correctly.
 
• It means easily seen or understood; obvious. (वास्‍तविक जैसा, आभासी, स्‍पष्‍ट; प्रकट, प्रत्‍यक्ष)
 
 
• **Example**: *The **apparent**__ cause of the fire was a faulty electrical wire.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, PLEGE**, is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is **PLEDGE**, which means a solemn promise or undertaking. (औपचारिक वचन या सहमति)
 
• **Option 3, AQUIRE**, is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is** ACQUIRE**, which means to obtain or gain possession of something. (कुछ अर्जित करना या ख़रीदना)
 
• **Option 4, CALENDER**, is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is **CALENDAR**, which is a system of organizing days for social, religious, commercial or administrative purposes. (पंचांग)

219:Tb10,

The correct answer is **"anachronism."**
